content.user_title: Manage SoftSync Tables and Workspace Schemas
content.value_statement: Unfamiliar workspace structures make table and field changes difficult to plan. This skill guides schema discovery and approved changes through SoftSync workspace tools.
actual_capabilities: Guide schema discovery for accessible tables, fields, field options, and workspace groups.
Interpret choice values, relation targets, system fields, and application-managed field behavior.
Guide table creation and field changes with upsert_table after user agreement.
Explain formula configuration, linked field references, validation failures, and background recalculation.
Guide numbered field counter inspection and adjustment within existing numbering constraints.
Guide permanent table deletion with an explicit warning, Admin access, and user confirmation.
limitations: Requires connected SoftSync workspace tools; this skill provides instructions rather than a standalone API implementation.
Schema discovery only exposes tables and groups available to the current user.
Table creation and field changes require Admin or Editor access; table deletion requires Admin access and has no Bin.
Sequence and formula fields cannot be written directly; linked totals and formula recalculation may update asynchronously.

use_cases.title: Review an unfamiliar workspace
use_cases.description: Inspect available tables, field types, choices, and relationships before planning workspace changes.

use_cases.title: Extend an operational table
use_cases.description: Plan new fields or calculated values, reuse existing structures, and request agreement before applying changes.

use_cases.title: Manage numbering and table cleanup
use_cases.description: Inspect invoice counters and plan obsolete table removal with clear warnings and explicit confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect the workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Describe my accessible SoftSync tables, fields, and groups. Summarize relationships and choice fields without changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a new field
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the workspace for a suitable project tracking table. Propose a Status choice field only if needed, and wait for my agreement.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: extend an existing table without duplication.

prompt_templates.title: Add a calculated amount
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the order table and identify quantity and unit price fields. Propose a rounded amount formula and wait for agreement before changing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: configure a calculated field using actual field names.

prompt_templates.title: Review invoice numbering
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the invoice sequence field and its next counter value. Check whether 1000 is permitted, explain constraints, and wait for agreement before changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: adjust numbering while respecting existing values.

output_examples.input: Explain how this workspace handles choice, sequence, and calculated fields.
output: Choice fields use stored values, which may differ from displayed labels.
Sequence fields receive application-generated numbers when records are created and must be omitted from record writes.
Formula fields are calculated automatically; formula-default fields allow user values to replace their defaults.

output_examples.input: What should happen before deleting an obsolete table?
output: Confirm that the account has Admin access.
Explain that deletion permanently removes the table and every record, with no Bin for recovery.
Describe the planned deletion and wait for explicit user confirmation.

output_examples.input: Explain what to expect when changing a calculated field.
output: Formula references use field display names, including linked field paths when needed.
Invalid formulas are rejected with an explanation.
Changing a formula recalculates existing records in the background; linked record totals may update shortly after saving.

best_practices: Inspect the workspace schema before using other workspace tools, and reuse suitable tables and fields.
Describe planned structural changes in plain language and wait for user agreement before applying them.
Use stored choice values and omit sequence and formula fields from direct record writes.
anti_patterns: Creating duplicate tables or fields without inspecting existing workspace structures.
Deleting a table without explaining permanent record loss and obtaining user confirmation.
Writing directly to generated fields or lowering a counter below a number already in use.

faq.question: Does the skill include its own SoftSync connection?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for connected SoftSync workspace tools and does not include a standalone client.

faq.question: Which parts of the workspace can it inspect?
faq.answer: The schema tool returns tables, field metadata, and groups accessible to the current user.

faq.question: Who can change or delete tables?
faq.answer: Admin or Editor access is required for table creation and field changes. Only Admin users can delete tables.

faq.question: Can deleted tables be recovered from the Bin?
faq.answer: No. Table deletion removes the table and every record, with no Bin for tables. The skill requires user confirmation first.

faq.question: How do formula fields differ from formula-default fields?
faq.answer: Formula fields are calculated and cannot be written directly. Formula-default fields supply initial values that user entries can replace until cleared.

faq.question: Can invoice numbering restart at any value?
faq.answer: The counter can be adjusted, but it cannot move below a number already in use. Inspect the current counter before proposing changes.
